chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Every human being has to meet the end, sweet or bitter.
ai.seo_question: What determines whether a person's end in life is sweet or bitter?
ai.summary: In this concise maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) encapsulates the principle of divine retribution, emphasizing that one's ultimate fate is the direct fruit of their accumulated actions. This statement serves as a profound reminder of accountability (Hisab), urging believers to cultivate good deeds to ensure a 'sweet' end in both this world and the Hereafter.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 151. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
Every human being has to meet the end, sweet or bitter.
